title: nodeforge configuration
description: Schema for .nodeforge/config.json. Unknown fields are ignored by nodeforge; fields with the wrong type are reported as issues and cause exit code 2.

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files examined per scan.

maxFileBytes.description: Files larger than this many bytes are hashed but not content-scanned.

excludeDirs.description: Directory names skipped during repository-relative scanning (symlink-safe).

enabled.description: Whether test discovery and guarded execution run as part of review.

timeoutMs.description: Hard per-command test timeout in milliseconds; the child process group is killed on expiry.

network.description: Test network policy. 'denied' strips proxy/network environment variables from the child process (best-effort).

runnerOverride.description: Force a specific detected runner instead of auto-detection, or null to auto-detect.

commandOverride.description: Replace the runner command with a custom argv. Every element must still pass the command allow-list; the argv is never run through a shell.

onBlocked.description: How review treats blocked test execution: report it as 'blocked' or ignore it and continue.

enabled.description: Enable optional LLM analysis. Disabled by default; deterministic scanning never depends on it.

provider.description: Analysis provider kind exposed behind the AnalysisProvider seam.

model.description: Model identifier passed to the provider, or null for the provider default.

baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL override, or null to use the provider default.

maxFindings.description: Maximum number of findings forwarded to LLM analysis per run.

backend.description: RunRepository backend. 'fs' persists under storage.dir; 'memory' keeps runs for the current process only.

dir.description: Directory where runs are persisted when backend is 'fs'.

artifacts.description: Whether raw artifacts are written alongside structured results in each run directory.
